morning.insight:
📅 FOMC 3년 만의 금리인상 — '인상이 동결보다 낫다'…키는 점도표와 워시 발언

새벽 FOMC에서 연준은 만장일치로 기준금리를 0.25%p 인상(3.75~4.00%)했습니다. 시장이 이미 90% 이상 인상을 선반영했던 만큼, 오히려 동결이었다면 혼란을 불렀을 상황입니다. JP모건의 '얕은 인상' 시나리오가 현실화된 셈입니다.

핵심 변수 3가지:
1. 점도표 '연내 추가 1회' — 위원 16명이 올해 한 번 더 인상을 전망. 워시 의장의 기자회견 톤이 '일회성(비둘기파) vs 추가 인상(매파)' 판단을 좌우
2. 유가 $98~105 — 이란·미국 긴장 해소 기미가 없는 한 $90~100 박스권 지속, KOSPI 화학·정유 수혜 vs 항공·운송 부담
3. 회전율 연중 최저 — 지수는 올랐지만 매수 주체가 좁아, 펀더멘털 확신 부족 반영. 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 150조 자사주 카드가 하방 지지

비둘기파적 인상으로 해석될 경우 단기 위험자산 랠리 가능성이 열려 있습니다. 오늘 장 초반 FOMC 해석에 따른 방향성이 결정될 전망입니다.

📌 관전 포인트: ①워시 기자회견 톤(일회성 vs 추가 인상) ②유가 향방 ③10년물 5% 지속 여부 ④KOSPI 6,700선 안착

articles.headline: Fed Decision, Dot Plot Take Center Stage This Week
articles.eng: Fed decision and dot plot in focus this week
articles.body: The Federal Reserve's decision and updated projections dominated a week marked by an AI-led selloff, rising oil and elevated yields.

articles.headline: Global Central Banks in Focus as BOJ and BOE Follow the Fed
articles.eng: BOJ and BOE in focus after the Fed move
articles.body: Attention turns to the Bank of Japan and Bank of England, with policy divergence widening after the Fed's first hike in three years.

articles.headline: Fed Raises Interest Rates for First Time in Three Years as Inflation Persists
articles.eng: Fed hikes rates for first time in three years as inflation persists
articles.body: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates a quarter point, its first increase in three years, as persistent inflation outweighed concerns about slowing growth.

articles.headline: Elevated Inflation Kept Pressure on the Fed to Raise Rates
articles.eng: Elevated inflation pressured the Fed to act
articles.body: Odds of a quarter-point increase surged to 90 percent after August's consumer price data showed inflation running hot.

articles.headline: What to Watch After the Fed's First Rate Hike in Three Years
articles.eng: What to watch after the Fed's first hike in three years
articles.body: Policymakers signaled additional increases may be needed to bring inflation back toward the 2 percent target.

articles.headline: Fed Officials Split on Path Ahead as Warsh Reins In Guidance
articles.eng: Fed officials split on the path ahead
articles.body: Policymakers remain divided between holding rates and further increases, bracing for higher inflation into next year.

articles.headline: Oil Prices in Focus as Middle East Tensions Keep Markets on Edge
articles.eng: Oil in focus amid Middle East tensions
articles.body: Brent crude held near $105 a barrel as an Iran-US standoff kept global energy markets on edge.

articles.headline: How Higher Rates Ripple Through Housing and Consumers
articles.eng: How higher rates ripple through housing and consumers
articles.body: The Fed's first hike in three years is set to lift borrowing costs for mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.

articles.headline: Fed Raises Rates Despite Trump's Demands for Lower Borrowing Costs
articles.eng: Fed hikes rates despite Trump's pressure for cuts
articles.body: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates a quarter point, defying President Trump's repeated demands for lower borrowing costs as it moved to tame inflation.

articles.headline: Raising Rates Will Curb Inflation and Maintain Fed Credibility
articles.eng: Raising rates curbs inflation and preserves credibility
articles.body: The rate increase may earn the president's enmity, but it signals the central bank remains independent and will not tolerate inflation persistently above target.

articles.headline: More Fed Officials See Hikes Ahead as Inflation Stays Elevated
articles.eng: More officials see hikes ahead as inflation stays high
articles.body: A growing number of Fed officials said further rate increases could be needed, with inflation still running well above the 2 percent target.

articles.headline: High Inflation Keeps Pressure on the Federal Reserve
articles.eng: High inflation keeps pressure on the Fed
articles.body: Inflation has slowed only modestly, leaving the central bank's sense of urgency to bring prices under control intact.

articles.headline: Warsh Reins In Guidance as Rate Hikes Return
articles.eng: Warsh reins in guidance as hikes return
articles.body: Nine Fed officials expected at least one hike this year, with six supporting two or more, as Chair Warsh scaled back forward guidance.

articles.headline: Oil and Inflation Keep Markets on Edge Into Fed Week
articles.eng: Oil and inflation keep markets on edge into Fed week
articles.body: Elevated crude prices and sticky inflation kept investors cautious heading into the central bank's decision.

articles.headline: Kevin Warsh Under Mounting Pressure to Raise Rates as US Inflation Persists
articles.eng: Warsh under pressure to hike as US inflation persists
articles.body: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh faced mounting pressure to raise rates as inflation persisted, with Evercore ISI's Krishna Guha saying 'a rate hike next week now looks like a go.'

articles.headline: US Central Bank Drops Bias for Rate Cuts as Warsh Era Begins
articles.eng: Fed drops rate-cut bias as Warsh era begins
articles.body: The Federal Reserve abandoned its easing bias, with US stocks tumbling as traders upped bets that the central bank could raise rates.

articles.headline: Wall Street Bets on 2026 Rate Rise as Kevin Warsh Takes Charge
articles.eng: Wall Street bets on a 2026 rate rise under Warsh
articles.body: Markets priced in higher borrowing costs by year-end as Kevin Warsh took charge of the Fed and signaled resolve on inflation.

articles.headline: Oil Price Swings Darken Global Trade Outlook
articles.eng: Oil swings darken the global trade outlook
articles.body: Analysts warned sustained high oil prices could shave 0.5 percentage points off global growth in 2026.

articles.headline: Will Kevin Warsh Offer Clues on the Fed's Rate Outlook?
articles.eng: Will Warsh offer clues on the Fed's rate outlook?
articles.body: Minutes from Warsh's early meetings showed many rate setters were concerned about inflation, raising questions about the path ahead.

articles.headline: Kevin Warsh Seeks to Reassure Investors as US Strains Mount
articles.eng: Warsh seeks to reassure investors as strains mount
articles.body: Warsh has reduced guidance on future interest rates, seeking to reassure investors even as economic strains build.
